text:
Iko Mba Ụwa FIFA nke 1966, nke e mere na England site na 11 ruo 30 Julaị, bụ oge mbụ e mere asọmpi ahụ na mba na-asụ Bekee. Ndị otu iri na isii sonyere na asọmpi ahụ, nke e kewara n’ime otu anọ nke nwere otu anọ ọ bụla. A kpebiri otu ọ bụla site na egwuregwu round-robin, ebe mba abụọ kachasị elu na-aga n’ọkwa knockout nke otu onye meriri, nke gụnyere ọkara ikpeazụ, ọkara ikpeazụ, egwuregwu ebe nke atọ na ikpeazụ.

Onye ọhụrụ kacha pụta ìhè bụ North Korea, nke pụtara na Iko Mba Ụwa maka oge mbụ. Ha tụrụ Italy 1-0 na agba otu wee rute ọkara ikpeazụ, ebe ha gbagoro 3-0 n’isi Portugal tupu Eusebio akpọlite mgbake dị ịtụnanya 5-3. Eusebio gosipụtara onwe ya dị ka onye ọkpụkpọ kacha elu nke asọmpi ahụ, na-agwụcha dị ka onye kacha nweta goolu itoolu.

Ikpeazụ ahụ na Wembley Stadium na London gbakọtara England na West Germany n’ihu igwe mmadụ 96,924. Helmut Haller na Wolfgang Weber nyere goolu maka West Germany, ebe Geoff Hurst na Martin Peters nyere goolu maka England, ndị otu abụọ ahụ kwụsịrị na 2-2 mgbe oge zuru. Egwuregwu ahụ gbanwere n’otu oge a ka na-arụrịta ụka na oge mgbakwunye: agba Hurst kụrụ n’okpuru crossbar wee daa nso na line. Onye ọka ikpe Switzerland bụ Gottfried Dienst nyere goolu ahụ mgbe ọ kpọrọ onye ọka ikpe Soviet Tofik Bakhramov, ebe West Germany na-arụ ụka ma bọọlụ ahụ gafere line n’ụzọ zuru ezu. Hurst mechara hat-trick ya na nkeji ikpeazụ, goolu atọ ya na 18’, 101’ na 120’ ka bụ naanị hat-trick e mere na ikpeazụ Iko Mba Ụwa nke ụmụ nwoke.

England meriri 4-2 mgbe oge mgbakwunye gasịrị, na-ewe aha mbụ ha nke Iko Mba Ụwa ma bụrụ mba nke mbụ na-anabata asọmpi ahụ meriri kemgbe Italy na 1934. West Germany mechara dị ka ndị nke abụọ, ebe Portugal wepụtara ebe nke atọ n’ihu Soviet Union nke nọ n’ọnọdụ nke anọ. N’ofe asọmpi ahụ, ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị bịara ruru 1,563,135, na-eme nkezi ihe dị ka 48,848 kwa egwuregwu.
